title: GTA Online Public Lobby Safety: Privacy and Scam Prevention
summary: Reduce GTA Online harassment and account risk using supported session and privacy controls.
intro: GTA Online is a social multiplayer environment, and how you choose sessions, voice chat and friends can affect your experience. A safer setup begins with the options provided by the current game and platform.

sections.heading: Understand session types before joining
paragraphs: GTA Online offers different ways to participate, but exact activity availability and session controls can vary by platform and game version. Review the current session menu instead of assuming every activity works the same way in a private or public lobby. An invite-only environment may suit a small group that wants fewer interruptions, while public sessions can support other multiplayer interactions. Choosing a quieter session is not cheating or a weakness; it is a preference for the style of play you want. Do not install network-breaking tools to force other players out.
points: Read current activity requirements before selecting a session.
Avoid third-party software that modifies network traffic or game behavior.

sections.heading: Review voice and message settings
paragraphs: Open the game's social and audio options, then check the console or PC platform's broader privacy controls. Limiting voice chat, direct messages or invitations can reduce unwanted contact. Muting one disruptive player may be enough in some situations, while persistent harassment can justify blocking or reporting. Do not share personal phone numbers, email addresses or social profiles with players you just met. A friendly voice conversation is not evidence that a stranger should receive account recovery details.
points: Check whether voice chat is audible to strangers or teammates only.
Prefer platform block and report functions to public arguments.

sections.heading: Recognize suspicious money and item offers
paragraphs: Promises of unlimited GTA dollars, modded vehicles or secret rank boosts can be associated with scams or unauthorized account modification. Never provide a password, verification code or remote-computer access to claim an in-game gift. A private message showing a giant balance is not proof of a safe method. If someone advertises special services, compare the offer with Rockstar's current rules before interacting. Unauthorized modifications can lead to lost access or penalties, and a third party cannot guarantee account safety.
points: Do not accept unexpected executable files from players.
Treat requests for payment outside verified services as a serious warning sign.

sections.heading: Protect your linked platform account
paragraphs: Use a unique password and enable supported additional authentication on the Rockstar and platform accounts connected to the game. Review recovery contacts and devices, particularly when you play on shared machines. If another player claims to be a moderator, verify the request through official support rather than sending proof of ownership in a chat. A real support process should not require your one-time sign-in token. Keep purchase records in a private location in case legitimate account recovery is ever necessary.
points: Revoke suspicious sessions through verified security pages.
Do not approve sign-in prompts you did not initiate.

sections.heading: Use evidence responsibly when reporting
paragraphs: If a player repeatedly harasses or threatens you, record the relevant in-game name, time and behavior without publishing unrelated personal details. Use supported capture and reporting functions, and distinguish rule violations from an ordinary competitive loss. Do not retaliate with doxxing, threats or edited screenshots. After sending a report, move to a different session or take a break rather than waiting for a public confrontation. Good privacy habits make multiplayer more enjoyable without promising that every hostile encounter can be prevented.
points: Keep recordings limited to relevant conduct.
Respect other players' privacy when sharing evidence.
